subject: Learning Methods
title: The Method of Loci
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Method of Loci.

hook.text: Memory champions memorize the order of a shuffled deck in under two minutes using a 2,500-year-old technique.

buildup.text: The method of loci places items you want to remember at specific locations along a familiar mental route.

discovery.text: Your brain excels at spatial memory. By linking information to places, you hijack a powerful built-in system.

twist.text: The more vivid and absurd you make each image, the more it sticks. Boring images fade; weird ones persist.

climax.text: Walk through your house in your mind. Place each item at a location. To recall, just retrace the path.

punchline.text: Ancient technique. Still the best for ordered lists.

quiz.question: Why does the method of loci work so well?
options: It uses rhyming which aids memory
It hijacks the brain's powerful spatial memory system
